newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIAN EX-CHAMPIONS LEVSKI TO BOYCOTT MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIAN EX-CHAMPIONS LEVSKI TO BOYCOTT MATCH.

text.p: Former Bulgarian champions Levski Sofia are pulling out of a domestic cup match on Saturday over the choice of referee, the club's president said on Friday.
Tomas Lavchis, quoted by the state news agency BTA, said the reason for boycotting the match against CSKA was referee Dimitar Momirov, appointed by the Bulgarian Football Union.
The Levski management accused Momirov of unobjective refereeing in last month's first division match against Neftohimik, a 1-1 draw. Levski are currently second in the league.
